messages.content: [User Role: CUSTOMER]
What seasonal fruits are fresh on Auxin today?

Welcome to Auxin! Today's fresh seasonal arrivals include Alphonso Mangoes, Banganapalli Mangoes, Fresh Papaya, and Sweet Watermelon. You can tap the 'Fruits' category pill on the home screen to browse all current harvests from local farms.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How does the search bar autocomplete work?

As soon as you type two characters into the search bar (e.g. 'ma'), Auxin instantly fetches prefix matches from the Master Catalogue, suggesting items like 'Mango (Alphonso)', 'Mango (Banganapalli)', or 'Mint'. Tapping a suggestion takes you directly to the aggregated product page.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How can I filter for organic vegetables under ₹60 per kg?

Tap on the 'Vegetables' category pill, toggle the 'Organic Only' switch to ON, and set the price filter slider maximum to ₹60. The marketplace grid will automatically refresh to show matching organic listings.
Can I save these filter settings for my next visit?
Your active category and organic toggles remain active during your browsing session. For quick access to your favorite organic staples, you can also add them to your Wishlist!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What does 'From ₹40/kg' mean on a master product card?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. 'From ₹40/kg' displays the lowest starting price among all local farmers who are currently offering that product. Clicking on the product card opens the full listing, showing individual farmer offers, prices, organic badges, and farm locations.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What does 'Harvested Today' indicate on a product?

'Harvested Today' means the farmer logged and listed that specific batch of produce on the current calendar date. This guarantees that your vegetables or fruits were picked fresh this morning rather than sitting in storage.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Does searching for Indian names like 'Tamatar' or 'Aloo' work?
Yes! Auxin's server-side full-text search maps common local names and aliases. Searching for 'Tamatar' brings up Tomatoes, and 'Aloo' brings up Potatoes, making discovery easy and natural.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Where can I find fresh farm milk and paneer?

Tap on the 'Dairy & Eggs' category pill at the top of the marketplace. You will find daily morning harvests of Cow Milk, Buffalo Milk, Farm Curd, Pure Ghee, and Fresh Paneer listed by local dairy farmers.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I saved Strawberries to my Wishlist, but now it shows 'Out of Stock'.
Wishlist items display real-time availability across all contributing farms. If all local farmers have sold out their current harvest, the item reflects 'Out of Stock' until a fresh harvest is added.
How will I know when fresh stock arrives?
Your Wishlist updates automatically in real-time. When a farmer lists a fresh batch of strawberries, the 'Out of Stock' tag will change back to 'Available' with the starting price.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I see which farm my produce is coming from?

Yes! On any product page, click on a farmer's listing to view their farm profile. You can see the farm name (e.g. 'Green Meadows Farm'), location (e.g. 'Chikballapur, Bengaluru Rural'), organic status, and farming notes.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How can I sort produce by harvest freshness instead of price?
Tap the 'Sort By' dropdown on the marketplace header and select 'Freshest Harvest'. This sorts products to show items harvested today or yesterday at the top of your feed.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can you recommend some fresh leafy greens for salad?
Certainly! Check out our fresh harvests under Vegetables > Leafy Greens: Crispy Spinach, Baby Carrots, Farm Coriander, and Fresh Mint. Filter by 'Organic Only' to find chemical-free salad greens!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
I searched for 'Dragonfruit' and it said 'No products found'.

If a search returns no results, local farmers currently do not have active inventory listed for that crop. You can tap 'Request Product' to notify local farmers and admins about demand for dragonfruit!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What package units are produce items sold in?

Produce on Auxin is sold in standardized units specified by master products: weight units (`kg`, `500g`, `250g`, `100g`), volume units (`litre`, `500ml`), or count units (`piece`, `dozen`, `bunch`, `pack`).
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Where can I read about the farmer's cultivation methods?

Under each farmer's listing on the product detail page, check the 'Farming Notes' section. Farmers share details like 'Organically grown with neem oil sprays', 'Naturally sun-ripened', or 'Hydroponically cultivated'.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Where can I browse fresh cooking herbs like Ginger and Garlic?
Select the 'Herbs & Spices' category from the main menu. You will find fresh harvests of Ginger, Garlic, Coriander, Mint, Curry Leaves, and Raw Turmeric listed directly by local spice farmers.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why did my search screen go blank when I set price under ₹5?
Setting price filters too low (e.g. under ₹5) can exclude all current farm listings. Tap 'Reset Filters' to restore default price ranges and view available produce.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why doesn't Auxin show duplicate product cards for Tomatoes from 5 different farmers?

Auxin V3.0 uses a Master Catalogue system. Instead of showing 5 confusing separate cards for 'Tomato', we group them into one clean master card showing total available stock and starting price. Clicking the card shows all 5 farmers transparently!
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Can I see all products sold by 'Auxin Green Farm'?

Yes! Click on 'Auxin Green Farm' on any product page to visit their Farm Showcase. You will see all produce currently offered by that farm (e.g. Tomatoes, Potatoes, Spinach) for easy single-farmer cart building.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I remove an item from my Wishlist?
Go to your Wishlist tab and tap the filled heart icon on the product card. The item will be removed from your saved list immediately.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What grains and pulses are currently in stock?
Under 'Grains & Pulses', local farmers have listed Basmati Rice, Sona Masoori Rice, Whole Wheat, Toor Dal, Moong Dal, and Organic Millets. You can purchase them in 1 kg or 5 kg packs.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How often does produce availability update?
Availability updates in real-time! When farmers log morning harvests or when customer orders are completed, inventory stock numbers adjust automatically on the marketplace.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Are the product images on Auxin real photos of the harvest?

Auxin displays high-quality canonical master images for standard catalog items. Farmers can also upload actual photos of their specific harvest batch, which are displayed alongside their listing notes.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
What is Auxin's 30-day harvest policy?

To maintain strict farm-fresh standards, any inventory batch with a harvest date older than 30 days is automatically hidden from search results. This ensures you only receive fresh, recently harvested produce.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
How do I find farmers closest to my location?
When your delivery location permission is active, Auxin prioritizes nearby local farms on your home feed, minimizing transit times and delivery charges.
[User Role: CUSTOMER]
Why should I buy produce on Auxin instead of a traditional supermarket?

Auxin cuts out middleman warehouses by connecting you directly to local farmers. You get fresher produce harvested within 24-48 hours, clear harvest dates, organic transparency, and fair prices that directly empower local farming communities!
